impact_narrative: Order queries are queueing behind a table lock, degrading roughly 450 order requests per minute.
cause_summary: Migration commit b2c3d4e5f6 creates an index on orders.customer_id without CONCURRENTLY, holding a lock that blocks reads while the index builds.

runbook_citation.heading_path: Orders Database Runbook > Migration lock contention
runbook_citation.why: Describes cancelling a blocking index build and re-running it with CONCURRENTLY.

next_steps: Cancel the blocking CREATE INDEX backend (pg_cancel_backend, see runbook).
Re-run the migration as CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY.
Add a CI lint that rejects non-concurrent index migrations.
